security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* https:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Fast, open-source native database GUI client with AI-assisted SQL workflows, git-style staging, and TablePlus ergonomics.
bundle.longDescription: DevDash is a ultra-fast native database client built with Tauri (Rust + React 18). Features git-style diff review, real-time bento telemetry, interactive ERD visualizer, and local/offline AI SQL assistant.
